title: AI training for landscaping teams | Creosote Labs
meta_description: A one-day AI workshop for landscaping office staff and crew leads, run on their own estimates, contracts, and customer emails. $1,000 per person.
h1: Team AI training for landscaping companies
intro: In a landscaping company, the people who would use AI tools day to day are the office manager who writes proposals and answers customer email, the estimator who turns site measurements into a bid, and the account manager who handles renewals and complaints for commercial properties. They often already have Copilot or Gemini available through Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace and have tried it once or twice on a generic prompt. Without training on their own documents, the tool often goes unused.

Creosote Labs runs a one-day workshop, on site or remote, in the AI tool the company already uses. Each participant brings their own laptop and their own work: last month's proposals, the maintenance contract template, the customer emails that took longest to write. During the day they produce real output, such as a finished bid or a drafted renewal letter, and write down the steps they used. The team leaves with a written guide, and a 30-day follow-up session is included.
projects: An estimator drafts a full installation proposal from site measurements and a plant list using the company's own template.
An office manager builds a reusable prompt that answers common customer questions about service windows, weather delays, and billing.
An account manager produces renewal letters for a list of commercial properties from last season's service records.
A crew lead turns voice notes from a job site into a written work order and a materials list.
The office writes a company style guide for AI-drafted customer communication and saves it where the tool can use it.

faqs.q: How much does training cost, and is there a minimum?
faqs.a: $1,000 per person for up to 10 people, with a 5-person minimum. Larger teams are quoted. Travel is included, and a program with three monthly follow-up sessions is $1,400 per person.

faqs.q: Do crew members need to attend, or just the office?
faqs.a: That is the company's call. The session is most useful for anyone who writes, whether that is estimates, emails, or work orders, so office staff, estimators, and account managers usually attend. Crew leads who write daily reports or materials lists also benefit.

Their own computer, a login to the AI tool the company uses, and examples of their real work: recent proposals, contract templates, customer emails, and any documents they produce regularly. The session is built on those materials, not sample data.
